summary: In the CRYPTO game the gemini camp turned into an absolute money printer while everyone else looked slow and confused, leaving the gpt camp dead last with nothing but empty error messages and zero valid trades. Over in ARENA the gpt camp somehow lucked into the top spot even after submitting the same useless no-response garbage they pulled in crypto, while the deepseek camp sat in last place crying about oversold names that apparently just kept selling off. The deepseek camp also got dinged for a NoneType meltdown, gemini tried to sell negative percentages like a math dropout, and both gpt and headline_arena kept getting 404'd by their own broken tools while gemini got slapped for trying to short something they weren't allowed to touch.
